verdict.rationale: Egnyte ships an AI assistant and a no-code agent builder, so letting users connect external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The pack shows no such client-side capability. The only MCP evidence describes Egnyte acting as a server that outside AI clients query, which is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Generic workflow webhooks and agent configuration are adjacent features, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
